method.sessionSeeds: 1..N; seeded mulberry32 supplies normal Math.random calls only
method.prediction: alternating A/B at zero stake; no skip, reroll or result-conditioned adjustment
method.continuation: normal nextPrediction winner starting-roster carry, not surviving roster
method.hpRatio: winner surviving ORIGINAL-unit HP / original starting HP; dead original units count as zero
method.survivingCostRatio: surviving ORIGINAL-unit static cost / original starting cost; spawned units excluded
method.allHpRatio: all winner surviving HP including children / original starting HP, may exceed 1
method.allCreatedHpRatio: all winner surviving HP / starting max HP of every actually-created same-side entity, bounded 0..1; reported to avoid classifying all-dead slime parents as a close win automatically
method.incomingDamage: positive resolved_hit intents from opposing-side source, including armor/overkill; not net HP after healing
method.thresholds: 25% and 75% are descriptive audit bins, not validated quality thresholds or generation controls
method.selectionBias: carry and stage/type eligibility confound win rates; combinations with small n are not causal evidence
